editorial:
Imagine you are a top-tier fighter pilot who just wants to do your job, but instead, you are stuck babysitting a movie star. That is exactly what happens to Paul Watkins. He is an American pilot in the Middle East who has to teach Tom Slade, a Hollywood actor, how to look and act like a real pilot for a big movie. The vibe starts off as a funny clash between a serious soldier and a flashy celebrity. You will feel the tension as these two very different guys try to get along while flying high above the desert in an F-16.

Once the action kicks in, the movie really picks up speed. The dogfights are exciting, and watching the actor panic while the pilot stays cool is a highlight. While some of the special effects look a bit dated, the story keeps you hooked. If you enjoy old-school action flicks, you should definitely check this out. It is a great pick for a lazy Sunday afternoon. You can grab it as a 4K Blu-ray to add to your physical collection or just rent it on Apple TV for a quick watch.
endingExplained: The movie ends with a high-stakes battle where Watkins and Slade have to fight for their lives. Slade finally stops acting and shows real bravery, helping Watkins take down the enemy jets. They manage to survive the crash and make it back to safety. In the end, Slade has a new respect for real soldiers, and Watkins realizes that even a loud-mouthed actor can have a heart of gold when things get dangerous.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves old school jet fighter movies and buddy comedies.
